facts.business: Competent Automobiles Co. Ltd. operates as an automobile dealer with Arena, Nexa, True Value, and Commercial showrooms and workshops across Delhi, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttar Pradesh.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has related party transactions which include among others, sale/purchase of goods to its subsidiary and other related parties. This area was significant to audit due to the significance of transactions with related parties including its wholly owned subsidiary during the year ended March 31, 2026; and related party transactions are subject to compliance requirement under the Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI (LODR) 2015.
